headline: IYRI’s 10.9% Yield Is Shrinking, But Price Gains Are Making Up the Difference
summary: IYRI hands investors a monthly check backed by real estate giants and options premiums, but the distribution has been quietly shrinking while the share price climbs. Whether that tradeoff holds depends on one mechanic most income investors overlook.
